title: 支 (to prop up, to support)
longExplanation: to prop up, to support. Pinyin: zhī

examples.sentence: 他的两只手放在桌上，支着脑袋，想着事情。
examples.romanization: tā de liǎng zhǐ shǒu fàng zài zhuō shàng， zhī zhe nǎodài， xiǎng zhe shìqing。
examples.translation: His two hands were on the table, propping up his head, and he thought about things.

title: 支 ((measure word for guns, songs, or armies))
shortExplanation: (measure word for guns, songs, or armies)
longExplanation: (measure word for guns, songs, or armies). Pinyin: zhī

examples.sentence: 给他十支枪，他就能拉起一支军队来。
examples.romanization: gěi tā shí zhī qiāng， tā jiù néng lā qǐ yī zhī jūnduì lái。
examples.translation: Give him ten guns and he can raise an army.

examples.sentence: 干工作不能光凭经验，还要有创新。
examples.romanization: gàn gōngzuò bùnéng guāng píng jīngyàn， hái yàoyǒu chuàngxīn。
examples.translation: When we work, we can’t just rely on experience, we also need to innovate.

title: 硬 V (by brute force)
longExplanation: by brute force. Pinyin: yìng V

examples.sentence: 虽然中药有点儿苦，但他还是硬喝下去了。
examples.romanization: suīrán Zhōngyào yǒudiǎnr kǔ， dàn tā háishi yìng hē xiàqù le。
examples.translation: Although the Chinese medicine is a bit bitter, he still bit the bullet and drank it.

title: 硬 V (to insist on V-ing)
longExplanation: to insist on V-ing. Pinyin: yìng V

examples.romanization: wǒ bù ràng tā qù， tā yìngyào qù。
examples.translation: I won’t let him go, he just insists on going.

examples.sentence: 她专心地织着毛衣，偶然也会抬眼看一下墙上的挂钟。
examples.romanization: tā zhuānxīn dì zhī zhe máoyī， ǒurán yě huì tái yǎnkàn yīxià qiáng shàng de guàzhōng。
examples.translation: She focused on knitting a sweater, and occasionally glances at the clock on the wall.

title: 尽快 V (as soon as possible)
longExplanation: as soon as possible. Pinyin: jǐnkuài V

examples.sentence: 新产品出了点儿问题，你和严经理尽快商量一下这事。
examples.romanization: xīnchǎnpǐn chū le diǎnr wèntí， nǐ hé yán jīnglǐ jǐnkuài shāngliang yīxià zhè shì。
examples.translation: The new product has some problems. You should discuss with Manager Yan as soon as you can.

examples.sentence: 刚开始工作，这样的错误是难免的。
examples.romanization: gāng kāishǐ gōngzuò， zhèyàng de cuòwù shì nánmiǎn de。
examples.translation: At the beginning of work, such mistakes are inevitable.

examples.sentence: 自从我到北京以后，身体越来越好了。
examples.romanization: zìcóng wǒ dào Běijīng yǐhòu， shēntǐ yuèláiyuè hǎole。
examples.translation: Since I arrived in Beijing, my body has gotten better and better.

examples.sentence: 专家们一致认为这是一种成功的产品。
examples.romanization: zhuānjiā men yīzhì rènwéi zhè shì yīzhǒng chénggōng de chǎnpǐn。
examples.translation: Experts agree (lit. unanimously think) that this is a successful product.

examples.sentence: 进行某(个)方面的训练，就可以在那方面的能力提高。
examples.romanization: jìnxíng mǒu( gè) fāngmiàn de xùnliàn， jiù kěyǐ zài nà fāngmiàn de nénglì tígāo。
examples.translation: If you receiving training in a certain discipline (lit. aspect), you will be able to improve your ability in that discipline.

examples.sentence: 在墙上写“某某到此一游”的行为是不文明的。
examples.romanization: zài qiáng shàng xiě“ mǒumǒu dàocǐyīyóu” de xíngwéi shì bù wénmíng de。
examples.translation: It is not civil to write “so-and-so visited here” on the wall.
